items.source: This annotation is targeted at Document interfaces, indicating that the framework should generate the document key value using the specified generator
items.translation: 此注解针对 Document 接口，指示框架使用指定的生成器来生成文档键值。

items.source:
This package contains interfaces and annotations relative to object-json mapping and the notion of a Couchbase
Storable.
items.translation: 该包包含与对象 - JSON 映射以及 Couchbase 可存储概念相关的接口和注解。

items.source: This package contains various events that are emitted during the lifecycle of a Spring Data entity.
items.translation: 该包包含在 Spring Data 实体生命周期期间发出的各种事件。

items.source: This annotation is targeted at building the document id using the attribute value.
items.translation: 此注释旨在通过属性值构建文档 ID。

items.source: This annotation is targeted at building the document id using the value as a part of a prefix build.
items.translation: 此注解旨在通过将该值作为前缀构建的一部分来生成文档 ID。

items.source: This annotation is targeted at building the document id using the value as a part of a suffix build.
items.translation: 此注解旨在通过将该值作为后缀构建的一部分来生成文档 ID。
